description: Close a manual position fully, or partly with size_usd or percent (Hyperliquid, Lighter, Polymarket), with a reduce-only market order. Read the result with get_close_receipt using the same idempotency_key.

idempotency_key.description: Retry-safety key; reuse it to read the receipt. Auto-generated when omitted.

percent.description: Close this percent of the position, 1-100 (omit for a full close).

size_usd.description: Close this USD notional (omit for a full close).

name: close_manual_position
